messages:
Maria Chen: Heads up — found a late-batch that re-ingested tokens into last month's ledger. Some customers got credits applied to the wrong invoice window. Investigating root cause now.
Devin Patel: ugh. Is this the same pattern from last quarter (prefix replays)?
Maria Chen: different. Looks like a delayed downstream retry from the ETL queue that landed after daily cutover.
Oliver Grant: can you paste the offending job id or query?
Maria Chen: job id `etl-reprocess-20240305-47`. Quick snippet of the audit log:
```
2024-03-05T03:12:44Z INFO reingest batch_id=447 delay_ms=86400000 queue_key=usage-agg
```
Maria Chen: the `delay_ms=86400000` is suspicious — looks like a retry backoff misconfig.
Sara K: billing-bot shows 42 invoices amended so far (small customers first). billing-bot: 42 invoices updated, total credits $1,280.45.
billing-bot: action: created ticket FIN-7423, tag: invoice-corrections, priority: P2.
Devin Patel: thanks. Immediate ask: can we freeze further auto-amend until we confirm windowing logic?
Oliver Grant: agreed. I can flip the `auto-amend` flag on the ledger service. Will do in 5.
Maria Chen: owner matrix proposal:
- short term containment: Oliver (flip auto-amend + stop reprocess jobs) — ETA 10m
- root cause (retry/backoff fix): Devin + infra — ETA 3d
- customer communication & credits reconciliation: Sara + finance ops — ETA EOD tomorrow
- audit & postmortem writeup: Maria — ETA 1 week
Devin Patel: assigned. For root cause, I think it's the exponential-backoff logic that uses milliseconds but reads env var in seconds — off-by-1000. I'll validate.
Sara K: customer comms draft: "We're applying a credit to correct a usage accounting window mismatch caused by a delayed re-ingest." Will share a template in #customer-success.
Oliver Grant: `auto-amend` flag flipped to false. Stopped active reprocess queue: `usage-replay`. Confirmed no new amendments after 1735123500.
Maria Chen: thanks. Next, need to estimate scope: how many customers affected historically when delayed replays occur? Devin can you run a query for reprocess jobs with delay_ms >= 86_400_000 in last 90 days and summarize unique customer ids + total tokens?
Devin Patel: running now. Rough result: 97 unique customers, ~18.2M tokens reprocessed across runs. Will attach CSV to FIN-7423.
Sara K: prioritization: recommend manual review for top 10 by bill impact, auto-credit remainder in bulk with notice.
Oliver Grant: manual review queue created: FIN-7423-REVIEW. I added checklist: verify window, confirm credit amount, sign-off from finance lead.
Maria Chen: recurring pattern note: spike correlates with bytesets > 50k and shard timeouts. Putting that in the postmortem hypothesis list.
Devin Patel: root patch plan: normalize backoff units, add a fast-path that rejects replays after cutover time (configurable TTL), and emit metrics for delayed-replay counts.
Sara K: timeline check: if Devin merges patch within 3 days and we release next deploy window, what about customers who already received wrong credits?
Devin Patel: we still need to reconcile and reissue invoices if credit window wrong. Tech will provide canonical token counts per invoice window; finance ops will run the corrective invoice job.
Oliver Grant: can we add a temporary monitoring alert: "delayed_replay_count > 0" that pages on-call?
Maria Chen: yes — add that. Paging threshold low for now.
Devin Patel: adding alert as `metrics:billing.delayed_replay_count > 0 for 1m` -> page oncall.
billing-bot: FIN-7423 updated: owners [Oliver Grant, Devin Patel, Sara K, Maria Chen], due_dates [containment:2024-03-05T00:30Z, reconcile:2024-03-06T23:59Z, root_cause:2024-03-08T23:59Z, postmortem:2024-03-12T23:59Z].
Sara K: will draft customer comms + business impact spreadsheet by EOD. Anyone opposed to a short all-hands note if top 5 customers affected?
Oliver Grant: do it. Transparency helps.
Maria Chen: final quick asks before we close this thread: (1) Oliver confirm no further reprocesses will auto-run, (2) Devin push a test of unit conversions for backoff, (3) Sara prepare invoice adjustment plan and timeline to customer success.
Oliver Grant: confirmed — no auto-reprocess.
Devin Patel: test pushed to staging, backoff unit conversion fixed.
Sara K: invoice adjustment plan drafted and uploaded to FIN-7423. I'll ping CS for outreach.
Maria Chen: great. I'll start the postmortem doc and link to FIN-7423. Thanks all — will follow up in 1 week with findings and long-term mitigations. :thumbsup:
Oliver Grant: :thumbsup:
Devin Patel: :rocket:
Sara K: :pray:
